title: Meet Zeynep Demirbas, the New York eighth-grader who tested whether AI can recognise stress; a basic machine-learning model beat ChatGPT-4o
description: Fourteen-year-old Zeynep Demirbas tested four AI models on 3,553 Reddit posts to see how accurately they could detect stress. MentalBERT performed best at about 82%, while ChatGPT-4o scored about 74%. Her findings suggest general-purpose LLMs may not be reliable enough for mental health assessment.
